summary.en: One diagonal highlight crosses a dark card once, clipped to its corners, and its top edge catches the light.
summary.zh: 一道斜向高光带在深色主角卡上缓缓扫过一次，被圆角裁住，卡的上沿跟着亮一下。

fits: Crowning the one hero card while it holds still: the plan, the product card, the result.
notFor: Light grounds or light cards (screened light is invisible there); more than one card; more than twice a film counting all light effects.

intent.en: A silent crowning: one pass of light over the hero card says "this is the one" without decorating anything else.
intent.zh: 一次无声的加冕：一道光扫过主角卡一次，说“就是它”，别的都不装饰。

content.en: One dark hero card in the scene (its rect), holding still; no text.
content.zh: 场景里一张静止的深色主角卡（给出位置框）；不需要文字。

fits.zh: 主角卡静止时给它加冕：方案卡、产品卡、结果卡。

notFor.zh: 浅色底或浅色卡（叠加的光在上面看不见）；不止一张卡；连同其他光效全片超过两次。

en: Four rules or it looks cheap: one sweep, one hero card, clipped to its corners, once only.
Dark card or dark ground only; on light it is invisible.
All light effects together at most twice a film.
zh: 四条约束缺一就廉价：单点、主角卡、圆角裁剪、只扫一次。
只用于深色卡或深底，浅色上看不见。
全片光效合计最多两次。

upstream.name: 单点扫光
upstream.summary: 深墨卡上 45° 高光带 translateX 扫一次，overflow hidden 圆角裁剪
upstream.use: 把光当另一种笔触（扫/擦）：暗场标题揭示（A）、主角卡加冕（B）

overlaps.note: the light as camera and edit (reveals and hides a scene); sheen-sweep is a gloss on one object
